title: The Quiet Cellar
author: O. M. Joubert
blurb: Ansel Dravenmoor, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
